test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank.

Your shirt is _____ same colour as mine.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "the same colour" **is a** fixed expression** in English.
 
• The definite article** "the"** is used because we are referring to a specific color that is known to both the speaker and the listener.
 
• Using **"a" or "an"** would be grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Your shirt is **the same colour** as mine."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **No article required:** This option is incorrect because the fixed expression requires the definite article "the".
 
• **"a" and "an":** These options are incorrect as they do not fit the grammatical structure of the fixed expression "the same colour".
